name: add_relationship_claim
description: Add a specific claim with evidence to an existing relationship. The response includes 'updated_claim' with ALL existing evidence for that claim - review this carefully before adding more evidence to the same claim. Only add evidence if it provides NEW information not already covered. Multiple evidence entries can support the same claim if they come from different pages or provide genuinely different perspectives. DO NOT add duplicate or near-duplicate evidence. Each claim should be a specific factual statement supported by evidence from the current page.

character_a.description: Name of the first character in the relationship

character_b.description: Name of the second character in the relationship

claim.description: Specific factual claim about the relationship (e.g., 'Aang and Katara married after the Hundred Year War')

evidence_url.description: URL of the wiki page that supports this claim

evidence_text.description: Relevant excerpt from the page that supports the claim (keep under 200 characters)
